Complex-phase equality follows edgewise modulus contraction and connected positive support.

value.rationale: C4 is the smallest 2-connected, noncomplete bipartite graph and the first canonical cycle beyond the triangle. The already-known universal four-vertex p=1 value 3/4 conceals different p=2 behavior: C4 has the new strictly smaller exact algebraic number and rigid asymmetric extrema, whereas K4 has 3/4 and S4 has sqrt(11)/4. The branch-cone proof explains the distinction structurally; this is a meaningful sharp model calculation in active discrete maximal-function regularity research, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
